created_for: E02A objective-task apparatus revision after v3 profile-aware diagnostics

provenance.source: Original deterministic items adaptively authored from E02A-v3 failure diagnostics
provenance.license: Project-internal; governed by the repository license
provenance.adaptation_basis: E02A-v3 raw-output patterns from e02a_candidates_v2.json under the eight frozen E01 profiles
provenance.design_policy: Target boundary behaviors with one-operation and shallow two-operation tasks inside the existing stable task taxonomy; avoid Boolean true/false and multiple-choice families because v3 exposed default-token/option bias; character-position probes are string tasks and operator/code probes are symbolic tasks; do not reuse v3 outcomes as validation
provenance.validation_protocol: Profile-aware calibration: 8 frozen E01 profiles x 2 seeded repeats per candidate; fresh 8-profile holdout on shortlisted tasks
provenance.scoring_policy: exact-match-v1 unchanged; no fuzzy scoring, answer extraction, or LLM judge
provenance.dependency: If E02B changes the profile set or profile prompts, this task calibration must be rerun before E03
